title: Sales event v1
description: One non-cancelled sale line, sent by a PaynEat POS instance to PaynEat ERP once the line is paid: when its bill is paid in full, or when a payment covering that line is made (a split bill). See contracts/README.md for when a POS sends it and how it retries.

schemaVersion.description: The major version of this schema.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable for this sale line across every retry, and unique across the chain, even if the POS database is reinstalled: for example `<pos-instance>-<database id>-<order-item id>`, `POS-SILOM-1-K3F9Q2-00001234`. It is also the event's correlation id: the POS sends it as `x-request-id` on every delivery (docs/TELEMETRY.md), which is why it keeps to that header's characters.

posInstance.description: The code of the POS instance as registered in the ERP. Must be the instance the credential belongs to.

branchCode.description: The ecosystem location code of the branch where the sale happened. Must be a branch the instance serves.

saleTime.description: When the line was paid: the time of the payment that paid its bill in full, or of the payment covering that line, with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), for example 2026-09-27T12:34:56+07:00.

menuItemCode.description: The ERP's code for the menu item sold.

quantity.description: For a menu item sold by count: how many, a whole number above zero, as a string. Exactly one of `quantity` and `weightKg`.

weightKg.description: For a menu item sold by weight: the weight sold in kilograms, above zero, at most 3 decimals, as a string. Exactly one of `quantity` and `weightKg`.

modifiers.description: The options chosen on this line, by the ERP's option code; empty when none.

quantity.description: How many times the option applies to each unit sold on the line: per piece for `quantity`, per kilogram for `weightKg`. A whole number above zero, as a string. The ingredients used are the option's recipe × this quantity × the line's `quantity` (or `weightKg`).

code.description: The ecosystem-wide code shape (docs/GLOSSARY.md): 2 to 32 capital letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
